# Shubham Sahu

Shubham Sahu is an engineering student and builder in Mumbai, working across embedded systems, robotics, AI tools, and web and mobile applications. He co-founded Aurigen.

Official portfolio: https://shubham-sahu.me/
Profile: https://shubham-sahu.me/profile/
Projects: https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/

## Official social profiles
- GitHub: https://github.com/https-shubhamsahu
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shubhamsahu9372/
- X: https://x.com/isag0011
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/https.shubham.sahu/

## Projects
- [R3Bin](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/r3bin/): An internship project connecting YOLOv8 waste detection, a touchscreen interface, and servo control through ROS 2. Stage: Internship prototype.
- [Niva](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/niva/): An ESP32 smart-insole prototype with a web dashboard, mobile app, and biomechanics rules that can be inspected. Stage: Hardware + software prototype. Website: https://shubham-sahu.me/niva/.
- [Aurigen](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/aurigen/): A visual programming workspace for ESP32 and Arduino: assemble blocks, inspect C++, simulate, then flash a real board. Stage: Live browser workspace. Website: https://aurigen-apps.vercel.app. Website: https://aurigen.tech.
- [NO SUS Canary](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/nosus-canary/): A Monad testnet experiment that gives each reader a differently worded note, then checks leaked text against those variants. Stage: Testnet experiment. Website: https://shubham-sahu.me/nosus-canary/app/.
- [SENTRI](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/sentri/): A residential-security prototype combining visitor history, explainable trust scoring, and an ESP32-CAM edge unit. Stage: Live product demo. Website: https://sentri-0011.vercel.app.
- [PD-Tuned Line Follower](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/line-follower/): An ESP32 line-following robot focused on PD tuning and handling noisy digital sensor readings. Stage: Hardware prototype.
- [NO SUS](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/no-sus/): An Android and web app for sharing documents, sending burn notes, and opening selected Drive files on a borrowed computer. Stage: Live website · Android + web. Website: https://nosus.foo. Website: https://app.nosus.foo.
- [crypt.ml](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/crypt-ml/): A multi-agent AML prototype connecting transaction rules, ML scoring, graph analysis, and an operations dashboard. Stage: Live dashboard demo. Website: https://crypt-ml-rho.vercel.app.
- [ResumeDB](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/resumedb/): A local-inference recruitment prototype with semantic CV search, assessments, and an AI interview workflow. Stage: Source available.
- [CertSecure](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/certsecure/): A role-based certificate issuance and verification workflow with university, employer, student, and admin views. Stage: Deployed interface prototype. Website: https://shubham-sahu.me/CertSecure/.
- [Honeypot Agent](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/honeypot/): A scam-engagement experiment that classifies messages, responds in a persona, and extracts structured indicators. Stage: Source available.
- [Cyber Cypher](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/cyber-cypher/): A payment-operations experiment with an observe–reason–act–learn loop and a Streamlit monitoring dashboard. Stage: Source available.
- [CareProof](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/careproof/): A caregiving-work prototype that turns activity records into a score, valuation, and shareable professional profile. Stage: Source available.
- [M-Indicator 2.0](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/m-indicator/): A responsive website concept for M-Indicator, bringing transit features, city coverage, and product information into one browsing experience. Stage: Independent website concept · M-Indicator belongs to Mobond. Website: https://shubham-sahu.me/M-indicator-2.0/.
- [Hacker House Goa Builder ID](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/hacker-house-goa/): A browser-based graphics tool built for Hacker House Goa 2026, combining builder passports, avatar frames, crew layouts, and QR codes. Stage: Deployed browser tool. Website: https://hhgoa-omega.vercel.app/.
- [VibeSplit](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/vibesplit/): A group-expense tracker by Shubham Sahu for trips, shared bills, and everyday spending with friends. Members can join through a shareable link and track who paid for what. Stage: Deployed web application. Website: https://shubham-sahu.me/VibeSplit/.
- [Solo Grind Fitness](https://shubham-sahu.me/projects/solo-grind-fitness/): A fitness PWA experiment that organizes workouts into quests, tracks progress, and uses ranks and achievements to make training more engaging. Stage: Deployed experiment. Website: https://project-solo.vercel.app/.

## Accuracy
Niva is a prototype, not a clinically validated medical device. NO SUS Canary is a testnet experiment. M-Indicator 2.0 is an independent website concept; the original brand and transit app belong to Mobond. Public GitHub links identify repositories or releases; some application source is private.
